title: Match the boundary to data, plan or ABI interchange
brief: IPC/Flight move data, proto/Substrait encode plans, and FFI crosses an ABI boundary. Each needs its own compatibility, registry and ownership contract.

choices.tradeoff: No query-plan semantics follow from serializing data.
Logical and physical extensions have different codecs; restore required registries/providers.

choices.choose_when: Exchange supported relational plans across engines
choices.tradeoff: Extension coverage and function mappings determine interoperability.
Follow explicit ABI/version and release-callback ownership rules.

claims.statement: LogicalExtensionCodec and PhysicalExtensionCodec serve different plan layers. Custom nodes and functions may need codec/registry support; successful encoding does not prove equivalent execution elsewhere.
FFI and stream boundaries need resource/release lifetime review. Stable ABI does not imply arbitrary DataFusion-version compatibility or durable serialization.
Verify a round trip including schema, required registration, custom nodes and execution results under the exact sender/receiver profiles.

implementation: Identify whether the payload is data, a plan, or in-process handles.
List extension codecs and registry/store dependencies.
Test restoration and execution in the receiver environment.
unknowns: This card is source-backed routing. Cross-engine round trips and FFI lifetimes are not executed in this probe suite.

evidence.scope: Pinned hosted rustdoc; availability depends on the consumer profile.

invalidation.reason: Review changed signatures, docs, availability, and newly viable alternatives.
